minutes_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Wednesday, September 18, 2019
_________________________________________________________________
1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee Was called to order at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, September 18, 2019.
  Members present: Terry Kistler, Lorraine Missick, Scott Snider, George Borst and
  Bette Donovan
  Staff Present: Bill Aguirre, Staff Laison, Yvonne Duran, Recreation Coordinator.
  Guests Present: Liz Kirk and Mike Quinn, La Verne Residents.
  It was moved and seconded to approve the minutes of the Wednesday, August 21,
  2019 meeting. Motion carried.
2. Guest Speaker: None.

  Unfinished Business

3. Nutrition Program: The average meals served for August was 38.

4. Bingo Report: August: Beginning balance was $3,075; ending balance was $2,368;
  change was $707. Average of 49 players per session. Expenses paid by check
  were: $200.00 bank draw: $175 bank draw. $300 bank draw. $5.00 bank fee. Total
  checks $850.
  A flyer was distributed to notify every one of the changes being made to save
  money. The total savings is $725. The Bingo Bugle ad is out. People from Chino are
  beginning to participate. Brandon is trying to set up a new screen.

5. Meals on Wheels: In August, 52 meals were delivered to participants. There were a
  total of 899 meals.

6. Account Balance: To date, account balance is $3,816.66.

7. Fee Schedule for Use of the Facilities: Everyone is paid up to date.

New Business

8. Upcoming Events:
   Saturday, October 19th – Halloween Parade at CVS Plaza, 10:00 AM.
  Wednesday, October 30th – Health & Resource Fair at the Community Center, 9:30-
  11:30 AM –Bone Density test available, Hearing tests, Blood Pressure and Glucose
  Screening, and flu shots will also be available at this event.
  Thursday, October 31st – Special City Sponsored Lunch (Halloween Theme)
  11:30 AM

9. Facilities Report: Veterans Hall roof is done. New A/C unit installed. Oak Mesa is
  freshly painted and a new sign was put up. Getting quotes for back side of craft
  room roof. Currently painting to update the main hall. SCE audited building – usage
  is too high. VA Hall is going to replace sign.

10. Public Comments: Mike Quinn asked about the homeless situation. Tri City
  Navigator is working with Pomona and Claremont. Police Department has a host
  team to talk to the homeless and provide information and resources to get help.

  Liz Kirk mentioned how helpful everyone at the center was when she fell.

  Scott reminded us of the Country Fair at Hillcrest on October 12th. Taste of La Verne
  is at the Airport on Oct. 15th. There will be 20+ restaurants participating.

  George gave an update on Golf. The Senior Golf League will be using both Marshall
  Canyon and San Dimas courses.

11. Adjourn: A motion was made to adjourn the meeting, motion approved, motion
  carried. The meeting was adjourned at 10:55 AM. The next meeting will be on
  Wednesday, October 16th at 10:00 AM.
